Franco Moretti  
Email: franco.moretti@email.com | Phone: (123) 456-7890 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/franco-moretti  
Location: San Francisco, CA  

A junior frontend developer with a focus on building scalable, user-centric interfaces for enterprise applications. Currently contributing to NexaFlow Technologies’ product suite, with prior experience at PixelPulse and TechStartups Inc. Prioritizes clean code, accessibility, and performance in all deliverables.  

**Technical Skills**  
- React: Developed reusable components for a dashboard interface at PixelPulse, reducing duplication by 30% through shared state logic. Implemented dynamic routing for a SaaS platform, improving navigation efficiency for 15+ user roles.  
- JavaScript: Optimized core library performance at TechStartups Inc., reducing load times by 25% through lazy loading and memoization techniques. Maintained a legacy codebase, resolving 12+ critical bugs without breaking existing workflows.  
- Next.js: Built a static export pipeline for a marketing site, cutting deployment time by 40% and improving SEO metrics by 18%.  
- State management (Redux/Zustand): Integrated Redux for centralized state handling in a real-time collaboration tool, enabling seamless data flow across 10+ interconnected components.  
- HTML/CSS: Refactored legacy stylesheets at PixelPulse, reducing maintenance overhead and improving cross-browser consistency.  
- Responsive design: Redesigned a mobile-first checkout flow, increasing conversion rates by 12% through breakpoint-specific optimizations.  
- Web accessibility (WCAG): Conducted audits for a government-facing portal, implementing ARIA labels and keyboard navigation to meet AA compliance.  
- Web performance optimization: Reduced critical rendering path by 35% at TechStartups Inc. through code splitting and resource prioritization.  
- Browser DevTools: Debugged complex issues in a real-time data visualization tool, using performance timelines to identify and resolve rendering bottlenecks.
